journey.name: Paste-to-Import — parse, publish, undo window
journey.description: The v1 primary import flow (spec §5): paste tab-separated lines, preview parsed cards, publish to the homeserver, observe the 10-second undo window, finish to deck detail. Requires a signed-in session (run journey 01 first).

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" in the bottom tab bar
Verify the "Paste cards" screen is shown with a text area placeholder "Paste your list here" (resource-id: paste_input)
Type the following three lines into the field with resource-id "paste_input": "dog,cachorro", "cat,gato", "bird,passaro"
Verify a live preview appears showing 3 parsed cards with fronts dog, cat, bird
Enter "Animals PT" into the field with resource-id "publish_title"
Verify a "Deck published!" success state appears with an Undo button showing a live countdown (resource-id: publish_undo) and a Done button (resource-id: publish_done)
Verify the deck detail screen for "Animals PT" is shown with 3 cards
